func TestGracePeriodUsesEachCursorsBacklogTime(t *testing.T) {
	clock := clockwork.NewFakeClock()
	b := fanoutbuffer.NewBuffer[int](fanoutbuffer.Config{
		Capacity:    2,
		GracePeriod: time.Minute,
		Clock:       clock,
	})
	t.Cleanup(b.Close)
	first := b.NewCursor()
	second := b.NewCursor()
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		require.NoError(t, first.Close())
		require.NoError(t, second.Close())
	})

	b.Append(1, 2)
	assertTryRead(t, second, []int{1, 2}, 2)
	b.Append(3) // first now needs the backlog

	clock.Advance(30 * time.Second)
	b.Append(4, 5) // second only now needs the backlog

	clock.Advance(31 * time.Second)
	b.Append(6) // evaluate both deadlines after the first has elapsed
	_, err := first.TryRead(make([]int, 6))
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, fanoutbuffer.ErrGracePeriodExceeded)
	assertTryRead(t, second, []int{3, 4, 5, 6}, 4)
}

func TestGracePeriodResetsAfterCatchup(t *testing.T) {
	clock := clockwork.NewFakeClock()
	b := fanoutbuffer.NewBuffer[int](fanoutbuffer.Config{
		Capacity:    2,
		GracePeriod: time.Minute,
		Clock:       clock,
	})
	t.Cleanup(b.Close)
	c := b.NewCursor()
	t.Cleanup(func() { require.NoError(t, c.Close()) })

	b.Append(1, 2, 3)
	assertTryRead(t, c, []int{1, 2, 3}, 3)
	clock.Advance(time.Minute + time.Nanosecond)
	b.Append(4, 5, 6)
	assertTryRead(t, c, []int{4, 5, 6}, 3)
}

func TestReadWakesOnAppend(t *testing.T) {
	b := fanoutbuffer.NewBuffer[int](fanoutbuffer.Config{})
	t.Cleanup(b.Close)
	c := b.NewCursor()
	t.Cleanup(func() { require.NoError(t, c.Close()) })

	result := startRead(context.Background(), c)
	assertStillBlocked(t, result)
	b.Append(42)
	got := awaitRead(t, result)
	require.NoError(t, got.err)
	require.Equal(t, 1, got.n)
	require.Equal(t, 42, got.value)
}

func TestReadWakesOnCloseAndCancellation(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("cursor close", func(t *testing.T) {
		b := fanoutbuffer.NewBuffer[int](fanoutbuffer.Config{})
		t.Cleanup(b.Close)
		c := b.NewCursor()
		result := startRead(context.Background(), c)
		assertStillBlocked(t, result)
		require.NoError(t, c.Close())
		require.ErrorIs(t, awaitRead(t, result).err, fanoutbuffer.ErrUseOfClosedCursor)
	})

	t.Run("buffer close", func(t *testing.T) {
		b := fanoutbuffer.NewBuffer[int](fanoutbuffer.Config{})
		c := b.NewCursor()
		result := startRead(context.Background(), c)
		assertStillBlocked(t, result)
		b.Close()
		require.ErrorIs(t, awaitRead(t, result).err, fanoutbuffer.ErrBufferClosed)
	})

	t.Run("context cancellation", func(t *testing.T) {
		b := fanoutbuffer.NewBuffer[int](fanoutbuffer.Config{})
		t.Cleanup(b.Close)
		c := b.NewCursor()
		t.Cleanup(func() { require.NoError(t, c.Close()) })
		ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
		defer cancel()
		result := startRead(ctx, c)
		assertStillBlocked(t, result)
		cancel()
